logic.run_selection: scRAW uses default/stable_generalist_stable_generalist seed42; other methods use the best Baron paper-logic transductive run by BalancedACC.
logic.deg: Gold-standard top100 marker list is computed from true cell types; predicted top100 marker lists are computed per predicted cluster.
logic.annotation: Best-mapping uses Hungarian one-to-one assignment; marker-overlap allows many predicted clusters to map to one gold-standard type.
logic.similarity: Cosine similarities are sampled from random cell pairs to estimate the high-similarity/over-smoothing region without materializing an O(n^2) matrix.

methods.source_note: scRAW default alias aligned to stable_generalist_stable_generalist; labels/embeddings loaded from common8 stable_generalist weight export.
